_doc: World treks (generated by tools/trails/world_tail.py from OpenStreetMap, ODbL, and the Copernicus DEM; never edit by hand). geo.enc: encoded polyline of lat, lon, metres.

trails.name: Corfu Trail
trails.why: The Corfu Trail is waymarked in strategic locations with yellow signs, bearing the letters CT and a directional arrow.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 9 - Trail of Innocence
trails.why: Take this 7 day route to explore and experience all that the Apollo Trails network has to offer.

trails.name: Athens Classic Marathon
trails.why: The Athens Classic Marathon The Authentic is an annual marathon road race held in Athens, Greece, normally in early November, since 1972.

trails.name: ST722 Dikaia - Edirne
trails.why: The Sultans Trail is a long-distance footpath from Vienna to Istanbul. The path passes through Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, East Macedonia and Thrace in northern Greece, and Turkey.

trails.name: ST532 Ptylákio - Edirne
trails.why: The Sultans Trail is a long-distance footpath from Vienna to Istanbul. The path passes through Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, East Macedonia and Thrace in northern Greece, and Turkey.

trails.name: ST531 Ivaylovgrad - Ptylákio
trails.why: The Sultans Trail is a long-distance footpath from Vienna to Istanbul. The path passes through Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, East Macedonia and Thrace in northern Greece, and Turkey.

trails.name: ST721 Svilengrad - Dikaia
trails.why: The Sultans Trail is a long-distance footpath from Vienna to Istanbul. The path passes through Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, East Macedonia and Thrace in northern Greece, and Turkey.

trails.name: Avgerinos - Morfi - Chrisavgi
trails.why: It is an amazing crossing path that moves constantly alongside the water and visits many stone bridges.

trails.name: 1 - Western Hydra
trails.why: Western Hydra - This trail circles the west part of Hydra, approaching monasteries, settlements and archaeological findings, as well as the highest peak of the island with panoramic views all along.

trails.name: KAS 02
trails.why: The Panoramic Ridge - This circular route connects the settlements of Sougia and Kamaria, through the trails of shepherds who used to traverse the stony passages of this place.

trails.name: M38 Diakofti-Avlemonas-Diakofti
trails.why: The longest route of Kythera Trails takes hikers through two beatiful seaside settlements and three places of Pilgrimage each from a different period in a circular manner.

trails.name: 6 - Apollonia - Panagia Toso Nero - Apollonia
trails.why: Sifnos Insiders - This circular route is the longest of Sifnos, taking hikers from Apollonia to all of the central mainland sites of the island.

trails.name: M11 Kapsali-Agios Ioannis Agriolies-Kapsali
trails.why: This circular route will take hikers around the southern part of the island, through cultivated land and remnants of recent civilisation, natural landscapes of the island and the millenia old archaeological findings in the cave of Agia Sofia.

trails.name: Samaria Gorge Trail
trails.why: A waymarked path of 27 km, +2,125 m, up to 1,227 m, from near Agia Roumeli.

trails.name: Archaeological route of Kantanos-Selino - Day 1
trails.why: The first part of this route takes hikers from Paleochora to Temenia, following a seaside trail at first and then a trail through the gorge of Anydroi and further mountain trails.

trails.name: Archaeological route of Kantanos-Selino - Day 3
trails.why: The third and last part takes hikers on a 14km route from Sougia to Paleochora, with open views trowards the sea, while passing by the Antiquities of Lissos, along the E4 trail.

trails.name: Kea Trail 03 - Aristeos
trails.why: The longest route of the network, which traverses almost the entire length of the island, starting from Ioulida and passing through hills with an impressive view and cobblestone paths with dense vegetation, reaching the pristine beach of ancient Karthea.

trails.name: Corfu Paths CC18
trails.why: The Southern Pantokratoras Ascent - Ascent to the highest point of Corfu, crossing the large karstic plateau located at the top of the island.

trails.name: Andros Routes 14
trails.why: One of the longest trails of Andros takes hikers on a route from Gavrio up to Ammolochos and down through the valley of the watermills to the village called Frousei.

trails.name: Vythos - Agia Sotira - Morfi
trails.why: A section of the main path entitled The journey of the river Primoritsa

trails.name: M4 Agapi-Sklavochori-Skalados-Koumaros
trails.why: The Road of the Water and the Castle - Trail from Agapi - Sklavochori - Skalados - Koumaros

trails.name: 3 - Hydra (Town) – Zourva Monastery – Zourva Lighthouse
trails.why: Eastern Hydra - This route connects the town of Hydra with the Lighthouse of Zourva in the easternmost edge of the island, through trails that cross fields, churches and farmhouses.

trails.name: KAS 11
trails.why: Travel through the Past - This circular route connects Sarakina with Voutas through old paths combining places of cultural and environmental interest.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 3 - Trail of Love
trails.why: From Abeliona to Andritsaina this trail follows the old path that was used for connecting the villages of the area, offering beautiful views and unique landscapes.

trails.name: KAS 06
trails.why: The Byzantine chapels of Kantanos - This circular route guides the visitors of Kantanos between the Byzantine churches of the area and the natural beauties of the place with a minimum degree of difficulty.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 8 - Trail of Simplicity
trails.why: This trail connects 3 settlements Abeliona, Marina and Skliros, through the agricultural and natural landscape that surrounds them

trails.name: M49 Amir Ali-Agios Nikolaos-Plateia Ammos-Amir Ali
trails.why: Nature in Contrast - Explore the wild Νorth of Kythera in this circular trail filled with contrasts, from arid, desert-like places to verdant valleys with plentiful springs and waterfalls.

trails.name: Archaeological route of Kantanos-Selino - Day 2
trails.why: The second daily hike takes hikers from Temenia to Sougia on an descending route to reach the sea while passing by traditional settlements and ancient Greek and Roman sites.

trails.name: Ios Mylopotas Manganari (Ridge Trail)
trails.why: island Ios Cyclades Aegean, about 4.5 hours backcountry hike, partially poor trail visibility and difficult terrain, only few spots at Kefala ridge marked by blue stripe and stone figures, take enough water and sun protection, no shops in Manganari

trails.name: Kassos Trail 3
trails.why: Old Agricultural Landscapes - This circular route takes the hikers form Arvantochori to the heights in the SE of Kassos with amazing views and back to the start via the settlement of Poli

trails.name: Andros Routes 9
trails.why: Take this long route stepping on old paved trails from Ano Aprovatou, above the west coast, to reach the settlement of Strapouries, near the capital of the island on the east side.

trails.name: Pachtouri - Dokimi -Mytikas
trails.why: A waymarked path of 15 km, +2,241 m, up to 2,006 m, from near Piáleia.

trails.name: Miloxori - Mouriki - Vlasti
trails.why: The marked trail can start from either of the two villages, with higher requirements if one starts from the Milochori, due to its low altitude, which is close to 680 meters.

trails.name: 4 - Platis Yialos - Fikiada - Platis Yialos
trails.why: Cedars, Olive Trees and the Sea - This circular route takes hikers from Platys Gialos to the balcony of Profitis Ilias Kondou chappel and down to the beautiful bay of Fykiada before closing the circle back at Platys Gialos

trails.name: Agkistri Trail 03 - Forest and Sea
trails.why: This route connects Myloi with Metochi, Kontari peak and Megali Dragonera through trails and forest roads before closing the circle and returning to the starting point.

trails.name: 2 - Filoti (circular)
trails.why: Circular trail starting at the eastern approach to Filoti, Naxos’s largest, animal farming village in the center of the island

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 06
trails.why: The Roads of the Castle- This route has a little bit of everything Skiathos has to offer - cultutral sites, natural beauty - everything except civilization.

trails.name: Santorini Trail 09 - The Ledge of the Caldera
trails.why: Walking across the Ledge of the Caldera, this most popular route of Santorini will offer hikers a taste of the geology of this island along with a continuous shopping promenade in one cosmopolitan location probably filled with walkers.

trails.name: M37 Diakofti-Viglatoria-Diakofti
trails.why: This circular routes starts at the sandy beach of Diakofti and explores the surrounding backcountry, passing by salt pans and the now abandoned sparsely populated region called Kamares.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 2
trails.why: Starting form Andritsaina this trail follows the footsteps of the ancient Greek historian Pafsanias towards the Temple of Apollo Epicurius, on a route with strong history from ancient times up to now.

trails.name: M7 - Vagia - Livadi Geranou - Vagia
trails.why: Start: junction of the road from Kampos to Livadi Geranou with the road to Vaghia. See: the beaches, churches, archaeological sites

trails.name: KAS 07
trails.why: Sea and Mountain - This route connects Paleochora with Gialiskari and Anydroi in a circular pattern that includes heights, coastline and images from the gorge of Anydroi.

trails.name: The Battery Trail
trails.why: The longest of the trails of Fiskardo combines antiquity, WW2 history and beautiful beaches in an almost circular route.

trails.name: Andros Routes 3
trails.why: This hike connects Chora and Korthi beach, through the closest to the eastern seaside settlements and along traditionally built trails.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 6 - Trail of Freedom
trails.why: Starting from Abeliona this trail takes hikers through lush landscapes and beautiful settlements towards the ancient town of Eira, and ends right within the arcahaeological site.

trails.name: 1 - Agios Andreas - Artemonas
trails.why: This hiking route takes you through the history of Sifnos, passing by places of great importance for sequential historical periods

trails.name: Apollo Trail 5 - Trail of Bliss
trails.why: This circular route takes hikers from Abeliona to the places associated with Pan, Lycaeon Mountain and natural landscapes, which along the centurieshave been filled with man-made structures.

trails.name: KAS 04
trails.why: Panorama of Selinos - This is an easy hike in the semi-mountainous backcountry of Temenia, in an area of older agricultural activities with an open horizon in all directions.

trails.name: Andros Routes 5
trails.why: This route offers another connection between Korthi and Chora, through the backcountry of Andros and some picturesque villages higher up on the mountainous terrain that separates the two

trails.name: KAS 08
trails.why: Nature, Geology, History, Religion - This route connects Azogire with Anydroi and the fortress of the same name in a circular pattern.

trails.name: KAS 01
trails.why: The Route of Lissos - This circular route connects Sougia with the Archaeological site of Lisos, combining antiquities, viewpoints, the passage through the gorge of Lissos and points of cultural interest in the area of Sougia.

trails.name: Andros Routes 6
trails.why: Route stretching parallel to the biggest river of Andros, Achla, towards the homonymous beach.

trails.name: KAS 12
trails.why: Nature in Contrast - This circular route combines panoramic views of the Pelekaniotis river valley with changes in the natural landscape and cultural interest as it takes hikers through the settlements of Kalamios and Moustakos among others.

trails.name: M2 Volax-Falatados-Myrsini
trails.why: The Georoute This trail showcases the 2 geological sides of Tinos walking right at the edge between the rocky landscape and the fertile land.

trails.name: Ios Chora Agios Prokopios (via Profiti Ilias Ridge)
trails.why: hike on island Ios Cyclades Aegean, about 3.5 hrs roundtrip, mountain hike from Chora Windmills up via Ridge of Profiti Ilias, Ag.

trails.name: Kassos Trail 1
trails.why: The settlements of Kassos - This circular route connects all the settlements of the sland through old trails between abandoned and cultivated fields.

trails.name: M44 Aroniadika-Friligkianika-Pitsinades-Aroniadika
trails.why: This circular route showcases the architectural wealth that was used to facilitate the traditional way of life in the Kytherian backcountry and takes the hiker back to times when defense from pirates and autonomous living was a reality.

trails.name: Poros Trails 5
trails.why: Get to the highest peak of Poros island in this circular route and walk by an ancient temple and a christian monastery.

trails.name: Kassos Trail 6
trails.why: Wild Kassos - This long route takes the hikers from Agios Georgios, Hadies to Agia Marina settlement, offering detours towards a beautiful beach and a unique cave which has protected antiquities from many historical periods.

trails.name: 5 - Apollonia - Panagia tou Niliou - Vathy
trails.why: The Hidden Sides of Sifnos - This route takes the hiker from Apollonia to the beach of Vathy, performing an almost complete traverse from the eastern part of the island to the western coast, through the always interesting backcountry of Sifnos.

trails.name: NEA M31 Potamos-Paliochora-Potamos
trails.why: Pirate Invasion - This route takes from the settlement of Potamos to the Castle of Paliochora, crossing gorges and cultivated land to reach the abandoned Castle of Kythera and to commemorate its fall.

trails.name: KAS 09
trails.why: The Turkish Fortress - This route connects Azogire with Anydroi and the fortress of the same name in a circular pattern.

trails.name: Vlasti - Basilikia - Siniatsiko
trails.why: The trail starts from Plant Square crossing the most beautiful acorn forest in the area ending at Basilica Fountain.

trails.name: Santorini Trail 12 - Akrotiri - Faros
trails.why: Starting from the settlement of Akrotiri this route takes the hikers through some unique coastal landscapes and seaside cliffs before reaching the lighthouse of Akrotiri at the edge of the cape.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 09
trails.why: Following the Water - The creek of Kechria and the creek of Acheelas compose this route which expands from the Monastery of Kechria, down to the beaches of Kechria and Lygaries.

trails.name: Hymettus Trail "18"
trails.why: E.O.S. Heliopolis - climbs in Hymeto and throughout Greece, climbing schools, sports championships.

trails.name: Andros Routes 11
trails.why: This route connects the sea-side settlement of Batsi with the mountainous village of Arni through wide trails, small settlements and with beautiful views that leave a pleasant impression.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 05
trails.why: The Roads of the Monastery - This trail connects the capital of Skiathos with the monastery of Evangelistria, giving acces to the rest of the network, either towards Kastro or towards the North-West part of the island.

trails.name: Andros Routes 7
trails.why: This route begins at Panachrantou Monastery, the highest area in ​​the Chora watershed. and descends to the western side of the island, in order to meet the archaeological site of Zagora, in a breathtaking balcony over the Aegean sea.

trails.name: Andros Routes 13
trails.why: Take this beautiful trail from Arni down to the beautiful Lefka Beach, following a scenic valley.

trails.name: KAS 10
trails.why: Walking with the Vultures - This circular route combines the ridge of Agios Georgios with the stream of Pelecaniotis and passes by the archaeological site of the Fournakia and bird watching sites.

trails.name: Kea Trail 02 - Elixos
trails.why: This route traverses a big part of the island from north to south, starting from Ioulida and ending at Agia Marina.

trails.name: Kea Trail 10 - Ydrousa
trails.why: The first part of the route is easy and flat, and uses the same path as route 1 until the Veniamin fountain is reached.

trails.name: Poros Trails 6
trails.why: A circular route highlighting agricultural produce in the northern part of Poros from the past up until today

trails.name: Andros Routes 18
trails.why: This route connects the settlement of Vakoni with Chora, through a series of beautiful settlements, while circumnavigating the watershed of Gerakonas.

trails.name: 4 - Melania
trails.why: A waymarked loop of 7 km, +318 m, up to 244 m, from near Amorgós.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 13
trails.why: Mountain and Sea - This route connects the beaches of Mikros Aselinos and Megalos Aselinos with some picturesque churches hidden in the pine forest of the NW part of Skiathos

trails.name: 3 - Apollonia - Platis Yialos
trails.why: The Agricultural Road - This route will guide the hiker from Apollonia to the wide beach of Platys Gyalos through terraced fields with their irrigation channels and places of religious interest.

trails.name: Ios Manganari Kalamos monastery (Canon Trail)
trails.why: hike on island Ios Cyclades Aegean, about 3.5 hours backcountry hike, partially poor trail visibility and difficult terrain, only few spots after Vigla Manganariou mountain pass marked, take enough water and sun protection

trails.name: Corfu Paths CC17
trails.why: Τhe Mountain Lake - The traditional settlements of old Agios Markos and Spartilas, an old hunting trail that goes up the mountain and a seasonal mountain lake.

trails.name: Mandraki-Stavros-Nikia
trails.why: from Mandraki via Moni Stavros to Nikia on historic road and stairs

trails.name: Corfu Paths CC11
trails.why: The Forgotten Paths - A small white church on a rock on the edge of the cliff. Hidden green valleys, old cobblestones, traditional villages and an abandoned settlement.

trails.name: Poros Trails 4
trails.why: A circular route through the ancient history and the agricultural past of Poros island.

trails.name: Corfu Trail Alternative
trails.why: The Corfu Trail is a long trail that crosses the entire island of Corfu, from south to north.

trails.name: Andros Routes 4
trails.why: This route leads from Aidonia higher above the Bay of Korthi to the monastery of Tromarchia on the slopes above the western coastline of Andros.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 04
trails.why: The Olive Trees Trail - As the name suggests this route moves mainly through olive groves in a circular pattern from Chorio to the north and back.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 09A
trails.why: Following the Water - This trail, branching from route 09, connects Megali Ammos Beach and the capital in the south with Kechria Monastery and Kechria beach in the north.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 4 - The Sacred Trail
trails.why: This route takes hikers from Abeliona to the top of Lykaion mountain where the ruins of the Temple of Zeus and a chapel of Profitis Ilias is located.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 14
trails.why: Forest and Sea - This route takes hikers on a tour of the northwestern beaches of Skiathos through pine forests, schrublands and coastlines.

trails.name: Andros Routes 2
trails.why: This route starts from Chora and takes hikers up to the mountainous village of Vourkoti, passing through wide paved trails, picturesque settlements and beautiful landscapes.

trails.name: Kythnos Trail 01
trails.why: Easy route with clear and visible paths. It starts from Chora and reaches the Castle of Oria, which has great views with steep cliffs, and was the medieval capital of the island.

trails.name: Andros Routes 12
trails.why: The most mountaineering-like of Andros routes. This hike connects two mountainous villages of Andros, Vourkoti and Arni, through a trail along the highest ridge of Andros, with unique views along the way

trails.name: Andros Routes 19
trails.why: Starting at Piso Meria, this route takes hikers over the last mountain of Andros to the south to drop them down to the beach of Stavros with views of Tinos island.

trails.name: Ios Kalamos Psathi (Coast Range Trail)
trails.why: hike on island Ios Cyclades Aegean, about 3.5 hours backcountry hike, take enough water and sun protection, no rooms or restaurants in Kalamos and Plakes

trails.name: Kythnos Trail 06
trails.why: This is a circular route with small altitude changes. It connects Chora with routes 6A and 5.

trails.name: Ithaca Trail 012A
trails.why: This uphill trail could be the return trip for trail 12, taking hikers from Kioni to Anogi throught the smooth landscape of Vigla.

trails.name: Kassos Trail 2
trails.why: The Geological Route - This circular route connects Arvanitochori with the unique cave of Stylokamara and the chapel of Profitis Ilias placed on a spot with panoramic views.

trails.name: Tromarchia Circular Route
trails.why: This circular route will take hiker from Piso Meria to the monastery of Tromarchia on a breathtaking hike above the western coastline of Andros.

trails.name: Ios Psathi Agio Theodoti (Paleokastro Trail)
trails.why: hike on island Ios Cyclades Aegean, about 4 hours backcountry hike, partially poor trail visibility on steep descend, take enough water

trails.name: M4B - Perastra - Komi - Tarampados - Loutra
trails.why: The Road of the Water and the Castle - Trail from Perastra - Komi - Tarampados - Loutra

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 08
trails.why: Faith and Antiquities - This route combines some of the most interesting cultural sites of Skiathos, such as Pyrgi, Kastro and a number of picturesque chappels in a circular trail under the lush vegetation of the island

trails.name: Kythnos Trail 08
trails.why: Starting by the port of Merichas, this route takes hikers to the beach of Flambouria.

trails.name: Bourinos - Messiano Nero - Siatista Shelter
trails.why: The entire route is well marked and the trail is clear.

trails.name: 10 - Apollonia - Kamares
trails.why: The Cursed Trail - Walk the donkey route that connected Apollonia with Kamares, passing by the church of Panagia Platanissa.

trails.name: Corfu Paths CC13
trails.why: The Long Makrades loop - An easy route that connects the four mountain villages of northwestern Corfu.

trails.name: Ithaca Trail 14A
trails.why: This trail can be used as a return route for the hikers of route 14, and connects abandoned agricultural landscapes through mountain slopes and ravines, offering awesome views along the way.

trails.name: Andros Routes 16
trails.why: Starting from Agios Petros, this route descends towards the seaside settlement of Batsi through the typican backcountry of Andros.

trails.name: Kea Trail 01 - Leon
trails.why: For the most part cobblestoned paths with impressive views The route starts from Ioulida and passes the Benjamin springs and the ancient statue of the lion of the archaic period, and ends at the beach of Otzias settlement.

trails.name: Ios Chora Pyrgos (via Agios Ioannis Prodromos)
trails.why: hike on island Ios Cyclades Aegean, about 3 hrs one way, mountain hike from Chora Windmills up to Pyrgos via Agios Ioannis Prodromos

trails.name: 2 - Kastro - Panagia Chrysopigi
trails.why: Towards the Miraculous Saint - This route will take the hiker from the old capital city of Kastro to the most important monastery of Sifnos through historic trails with great views while passing two beautiful beaches along the way.

trails.name: Trail of Pan I
trails.why: This trail takes hikers from Neda to Ano Karyes through quiet dirt roads with great views and with an opportunity to visit the sanctuary of Zeus on top of Mt. Lykaion

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 12
trails.why: Kalamaki Loop Trail - This is a circular route that passes by the beaches and viewpoints of Kanapitsa mostly on dirt roads and it is ideal for jogging.

trails.name: 7 - Artemonas - Agios Simeon
trails.why: The Pilgrimage Route - This trail takes the hikers from Artemonas to Agios Symeno through the still cultivated backcountry of Sifnos.

trails.name: Siatista Shelter - Bourinos
trails.why: The ascent starts from the EOS Siatista refuge at the site of Xiamia and ends at the summit of Drysinikos 1866m.

trails.name: 4 - Hydra (Town) – Mandraki – Hydra (Town)
trails.why: The Heroic Harbour - Trail 4 is essentially a short circular hike and starts from the port of Hydra

trails.name: Kea Trail 04 - Drys
trails.why: Short route with steep altitude changes. Its dominant element is the intense vegetation and the occasional steep slopes.

trails.name: Kea Trail 09 - Artemis
trails.why: A relatively easy route with smooth slopes. It connects Ioulida with Ellinika. It uses beautiful dirt roads and some goat trails and paths.

trails.name: M6 Stavros - Psili Ammos - Stavros
trails.why: Interesting but difficult route Start: Diakofti, at the end of the road leading to the southeast peninsula of Patmos.

trails.name: Ithaca Trail 12
trails.why: Travel in Time - This one of the most popular hiking routes of Ithaca. It connects the mountainous Anogi with the seaside Kioni, a village which was founded by the inhabitants of Anogi in the early 1800s, when the threat of pirates had diminished

trails.name: Ios Manganari Kalamos Trail
trails.why: traditional footway connecting Manganari and Kalamos via Tris Ekklisies and Papas bays, about 1.5 hours, take enough water and sun protection

trails.name: Ithaca Trail 01
trails.why: Guided by Homer's Verses - Take this route to visit the Plateau of Marathias and its unique sights, starting from Perachori.

trails.name: Hydra Trail 1A
trails.why: This small route gives hikers of Trail 1 the oportunity to move further west across the islandish landscapes and reach Bisti beach.

trails.name: 8 - Artemonas - Agios Sostis
trails.why: The Route of the Mines - This trail takes the hikers from Artemonas to the ancient mines in the northeast of Sifnos.

trails.name: KAS 05
trails.why: This route combines part of the E4 route with the gorge of Fygos to create a beautiful circular route in the wild landscape of the Cretan White Mountains.

trails.name: Santorini Trail 10 - Finikia - Kolumbos
trails.why: This downhill route takes hikers from the ledge of the Caldera, down to the eastern coastline of Santorini, close to the underwater volcano of Kolumbos, through a beautful traditonal settlement and abandoned agrcultural land.

trails.name: Kythnos Trail 04
trails.why: Route 4 connects Chora with the beach of Agios Ioannis, through, for the most part, easy paths.

trails.name: Skiathos Trail 10
trails.why: Water and Wind - This route connects the peak of Elatos with the creek of Acheelas, mixing great views with lush vegetation.

trails.name: Agkistri Trail 01 - The Villages
trails.why: This circular route connects Megalochori, the capital of Agkistri, with Skala Beach and Skala, combining the traditional elements of Megalochori with the beaches and resorts of the island.

trails.name: Andros Routes 15
trails.why: Starting from outside of Gavrio this route takes hikers to the settlement of Ano Agios Petros, and then down to the ancient tower on the way to the beach of Agios Petros.

trails.name: Kassos Trail 4
trails.why: The Peak of Kassos - This is the summit route of Kassos bringing hikers from the plateau of Skafi to the peak of Megalos Prionas.

trails.name: The Cypress Trail
trails.why: This circular trail takes hikers through abandoned agricultural and forested landscapes just south of Fiskardo

trails.name: M1 Steni-Karya-Xompourgo-Steni
trails.why: This trail crosses circles around the highlands of Tinos, passing by villages and farmlands while keeping visual contact with the caste of Xombourgo.

trails.name: Ios Mylopotas Analipsi Mersina
trails.why: about 2.5 hrs round hike along ridge and rock coast passing three historic chapels, nice view of Mylopotas bay, trail partially in difficult terrain, take enough water and sun protection

trails.name: Santorini Trail 02 - Mesa Gonia - Pyrgos - Emporio
trails.why: This route ascends from Mesa Gonia to Pyrgos and descends towards Emporio to give the hiker beautiful views of the agricultural land that surrounds these settlements and great sights of the historic core and the traditional archtecture inside them.

trails.name: M41 Valley of the Watermills
trails.why: Dive into the secrest of Kythera following this circular trail through the valley of Mylopotamos with its waterfalls and watermills to connect the castle of Kato Chora with the settlement of Mylopotamos.

trails.name: Bulgarian path
trails.why: Learn about the Bulgarian Trail starting from Stalis to Mohos village, Crete

trails.name: Agkistri Trail 04 - From the Sea to the Sky
trails.why: This circular route connects the camping area of ​​Megali Dragonera with Agia Varvara through built paths and while approaching panoramic view points.

trails.name: M12 Kapsali-Agios Ioannis En Krimno-Moulin de Apokleistra-Kapsali
trails.why: This short circular walk takes hikers from Kapsali beach to the heights of Agios Ioannis "En Krimno" church and back down throught the backcountry of Kythera island.

trails.name: Kea Trail 12-2 - Piiessa
trails.why: With Route 12-2 hikers starting from Pissa will reach the settlement of Kato Meria. Contains parts that are in a relatively bad condition.

trails.name: Andros Routes 10
trails.why: This trail connects the settlements of Mesathouri and Apikia through a mountain saddle and a beautiful forest.

trails.name: Andros Routes 9a
trails.why: Take this route to explore the archaelogic findings both in the museum of Paleopolis and in the arcahelogical site of the ancient port.

trails.name: Aprovatou Circular Route
trails.why: This small circular route connects the neigbourhoods of Ano Aprovatou with the beach of Koutsi and Kato Aprovatou through scenic trails and with great views.

trails.name: Santorini Trail 13 - Akrotiri - Vlichada beach
trails.why: This route takes hikers from the settlement of Akrotiri to the impressive Vlichada beach through vine fields and dirt roads.

trails.name: Andros Routes 17
trails.why: A relatively short, circular route takes hikers from Chora to Livadia, circumventing "Megalos Potamos", the big ravine that drains the watershed of Gerakonas.

trails.name: M4A Agapi-Sklavochori - Skalados - Koumaros
trails.why: The Road of the Water and the Castle - Trail from Agapi to Koumaros

trails.name: Chartes Circular Route
trails.why: This circular route around the almost abandoned settlement of Chartes, is a nice walk with open views but it has not been much cared for.

trails.name: Apollo Trail 1 - Trail of Healing
trails.why: This route will lead hikers from the traditonal village of Abeliona through oak and chestnut forests to the famed temple of Apollo Epicurius

trails.name: Kythnos Trail 06A
trails.why: Route 6A connects two beaches with the ancient city of Kythnos also known as Vryokastro. A route with steep slopes and paths with difficult footing, either due to vegetation or stones, but it offers some of the best views of the island

trails.name: Poros Trails 3
trails.why: Hike to the impressive lighthouse of Dana through the backcountry of Poros

trails.name: Santorini Trail 01 - Pyrgos - Prophet Elias Monastery - Ancient Thera
trails.why: Hike from the settlement of Pyrgos to Ancient Thira across the ridge of Profitis Ilias on this linear route.

trails.name: Ithaca Trail 03
trails.why: Walking through History - This trail takes hikers form the port of Vathy to the medieval capital of Paleochora through a winding trail that crosses abandoned fields and remnants of agricultural land uses.

trails.name: Makaza pass
trails.why: Makaza, previously also known as Balkan Toresi, is a mountain pass in the Eastern Rhodope Mountains, connecting southernmost central Bulgaria with north-easternmost Greece and thus the regions of Northern and Western Thrace.

trails.name: Κόρακας summit
trails.why: Vardousia is a mountain in northwestern Phocis and southwestern Phthiotis, Greece. Its highest peak, Korakas reaches 2,495 m above sea level, making it the second-tallest summit in Central Greece after Giona.

trails.name: Psiloritis summit
trails.why: Mount Ida, known variously as Idha, Ídhi, Idi, Ita. The massif including the mountain is called Psiloritis.

trails.name: Spathi summit
trails.why: Dikti (also called Spathi) is the highest mountain on the Greek island of Crete.

trails.name: Afentis Christos summit
trails.why: The mountain of Lord Christ together with the adjacent peak Pisiri Madara (Madares in Cretan is part of the Diktis or Lassithiotika mountain range in eastern Crete.

trails.name: Volakiás summit
trails.why: A footpath to the summit: 4.6 km each way, +596 m, up to 2,092 m, from near Chania.

trails.name: Trapezitsa summit
trails.why: Trapezia is a mountain range on the border between the mountains of Timphi and Smolyka in northern Pind, Greece.

trails.name: Oligirtos summit
trails.why: Oligyrtos is a mountain located at the junction of Arcadia, Corinthia and Argolis in the northeastern Peloponnese in Greece.

trails.name: Mitsikeli summit
trails.why: Mitsikeli is a mountain range in the central part of the Pindus mountains, in Epirus, Greece.

trails.name: Kedros summit
trails.why: Mount Kedros, is a mountain on the island of Crete in Greece. It is located southwest of the Ida massif with which it forms the two flanks of the Amari Valley.

trails.name: Kokkinolakka summit
trails.why: A footpath to the summit: 2.7 km each way, +186 m, up to 1,765 m, from near Piáleia.

trails.name: Fengari summit
trails.why: Fengari, also known as Saos is the tallest mountain in the Aegean island of Samothrace, Greece, with an elevation of 1,611 metres.
